title: Omega Mag-Bind Bacterial DNA 96 Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Air dry magnetic beads for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add RNase A and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 µL RNase A to each sample and mix by pipetting up and down 20 times.

steps.title: Incubate RNase reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add MSL buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL MSL buffer to each sample.

steps.title: Add Mag‑Bind particles
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL Mag‑Bind particles to each sample and mix by pipetting up and down 20 times.

steps.title: Add ethanol and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 528 µL ethanol to each sample and mix by pipetting up and down 20 times.

steps.title: Incubate ethanol step
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module (first)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and hold for 15 minutes to allow bead capture.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well without disturbing the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Disengage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Disengage the magnetic module to release the beads.

steps.title: First SPM wash
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL SPM buffer to each sample, resuspend the magnetic beads, and incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Capture beads (first wash)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 15 minutes to collect the beads.

steps.title: Discard wash supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Second SPM wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the SPM wash: transfer 400 µL SPM buffer, resuspend beads, and incubate 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Capture beads (second wash)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 15 minutes to collect the beads.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads (short)
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the magnetic beads on the plate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove residual liquid
steps.instruction: Aspirate any remaining residual supernatant from the beads.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads (final)
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the beads for an additional 15 minutes until completely dry.
